verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that DBOS queues provide flow control over how many workflows run at once or how often they start. That amounts to concurrency and rate limiting, which can throttle a noisy stream but does not collapse it. Cron scheduling and per-topic message queues are adjacent primitives, but none of the evidence shows events being merged into fewer runs. Missing for 10: explicit debounce, batching of multiple events into one run, delayed or deferred workflow start, deduplication of rapid triggers, and any hands-on corroboration.
